headline: Milwaukee Surges, Dodgers Crash Out
caption:
On Sep 27, Milwaukee was a 26% shot at the World Series. Now it's 67%.

The Brewers are the biggest riser, peaking at 69% along the way. Tampa Bay climbed too, from 10% to 33%, and is sitting at its peak.

The biggest faller is LA. The Dodgers started at 24%, rose as high as 37%, and are now at 0%. Cleveland (peak 20%) and New York (peak 17%) are also down to 0%.

Our model simulates the rest of the season and the playoffs thousands of times each day. Can Tampa Bay flip the script?
